reference_commit: ctsm5.4.063 (ESCOMP/CTSM be1aff2f2) + instrument/clm-dumps: clm src ac5192b7d (001bd2f1d -> c907ec2e5 -> ac5192b7d) / superproject 4181331 (51f5671 -> a8184a4 -> 4181331), branch instrument/clm-dumps in stage1/EqESM-cesm-ctsm
description: CTSM (CLM) boundary traces from an instrumented I-class CESM run (compset I2000Clm60Sp = 2000_DATM%GSWP3v1_CLM60%SP_SICE_SOCN_MOSART_DGLC%NOEVOLVE_SWAV). Default-gated by dump_clm=.false. and enabled in this run only. FIRST SLICE, prioritizing the urban (CLMU) / radiation / surface-energy path so the existing (unverified) EarthSciModels CLMU can be checked against real CESM: (a) D-boundary pointwise laws - the saturation specific humidity law QSat(T,p); the urban albedo law (UrbanAlbedo: per-surface reflected/absorbed solar + albedos); the urban longwave canyon law (UrbanRadiation/net_longwave: net+upward longwave per roof/road/wall); the urban canyon turbulent-transfer boundary (UrbanFluxes exit); the ground surface albedo (SurfaceAlbedo: soil/snow/ground albedo); the two-stream absorbed/reflected shortwave partition (SurfaceRadiation); the bare-ground turbulent-flux boundary (BareGroundFluxes); and the soil/surface energy-balance boundary (SoilFluxes). PET 0 only, first dump_first_cols points of each filter x first dump_first_steps steps, OMP-critical writes, EqIce-style CSV headers.

NOTE: with dump_first_cols=16 the traced non-lake filter is all soil patches on PET 0 (ctype=1); urban road/roof patches are not among the first 16 points, so this file carries no urban rows in this run.

traced_domain.points: first dump_first_cols=16 points of each call's filter (landunit / column / patch), on PET 0
traced_domain.steps: first dump_first_steps=12 model steps (dump_enabled uses get_nstep() <= 12); the run is 1 day = 48 steps. QSat/UrbanFlux-less calls run every step (steps 1..12); SurfaceAlbedo/UrbanAlbedo/UrbanRadiation run only on radiation steps (doalb), so their files hold 11 distinct steps (2..12).
traced_domain.indices: each row carries the CLM subgrid coordinates (landunit l / column c / patch p) and itype (ltype/ctype/ptype) so stage-2 tests can select the regime (soil vs crop vs urban vs lake vs glacier); kind=nourban|urban selects the surface-albedo column filter
